blocks.content: Excellent work! Your game looks amazing and plays perfectly. But before you celebrate, there's one more important step that separates beginners from professional developers: code organization.

Right now, your code works, but if you came back to it in a month (or if someone else tried to understand it), it might be confusing. Professional developers write code that's easy to read, understand, and modify.

items: Organize your code into clear sections
Add helpful comments explaining what things do

blocks.content: These habits will serve you in every project you build. Let's finish strong!
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
